svg.title: How the diagrams fix themselves
svg.desc: A pull request that adds a mermaid block or changes a diagram, and Renovate with a new version of mermaid-cli, run the check diagrams, which draws the diagrams anew. On a branch of the repository, the diagram bot commits the sources and pictures onto the branch, and the checks run again; a fork keeps the failing check, which says the command. After the merge, and every week, main is drawn too: when a diagram is not yet a picture of its source, one pull request from bot/diagrams fixes it and merges itself. So every reader sees every diagram.
